responsibilities.description: Regulated Indonesian investment platform where ~5M registered users trade US stocks, crypto and gold in one app, from fractional US shares to on-chain token swaps.

projectsAndAchievements: Led the backend launch of the Web3 swap product, a new revenue channel with 180K+ tokens on Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain and Solana, built on event-driven Spring Boot and Pub/Sub, bundling each swap and transfer into one on-chain transaction, with a Redis-locked ledger to prevent double charges and auto-recovery of stuck swaps.

Led the regulatory reporting migration for trades, transfers and staking to a new crypto exchange and clearing house, sustaining a 99.8% reporting success rate with a Cloud Scheduler job, Redis locking and auto-resubmission of failures.

Cut new approval-flow build time by ~60% by designing a shared maker-checker service in Spring Boot and PostgreSQL, with a state machine and audit history, built to replace 4 separate implementations.

Reduced market data subscription costs by ~20% by replacing per-ticker on-demand refreshes with a Spring Scheduler batch job with a Redis lock and Spring Cache, eliminating duplicate requests to the data provider.

Removed a single point of failure in the Go real-time price service by isolating 5 exchange WebSocket feeds into independent, self-healing connections, so one exchange outage no longer stops prices for the whole app.
Mentored 2 engineering interns to independently own production code through design discussions and code reviews, and paired with a frontend engineer moving to backend.

responsibilities.description: Focused on the account and identity domain, handling authentication, KYC, fraud detection, and risk management.

projectsAndAchievements: Turned 39.6% of low-confidence KYC rejections into approvals by re-architecting a synchronous verification flow into an async Pub/Sub pipeline across 4 identity vendors with face-search fallback, ending manual resubmission.

Cut 2FA-reset support tickets by ~78% by replacing a manual process with a self-service Spring Boot flow that verifies users step by step, from OTP to ID number, with short-lived tokens that block skipped steps.

Migrated ~5M users' core identity data from Datastore to PostgreSQL with zero downtime, moving read-heavy traffic off Datastore's per-operation pricing via feature-flagged dual writes and batch backfill, and enabling relational joins.

Enabled fee discounts and priority support for high-value investors by designing a daily tiering pipeline over ~5M users as a GKE CronJob with keyset pagination, combining asset balances with trading volume.

responsibilities.description: Enterprise technology arm of Sinar Mas Mining, part of Indonesia's Sinar Mas conglomerate.

projectsAndAchievements: Led backend development of Alerta, an in-house incident management platform in Go, PostgreSQL and Redis with two-way Jira sync and Slack alerts, built as an Opsgenie alternative with a business case projecting ~95% lower monthly cost.
Raised unit test coverage from 0% to 94% with Testify and moved Alerta from a single VM to Kubernetes (GKE) and managed GCP services, using Docker, Helm, Terraform and Cloud Build.
Restored valid user requests that were silently rejected by a stale distributed lock in Java/Spring Boot authentication services, diagnosing the root cause as a missed lock-release path.
